news.title: Chubb set as main U.S. insurer for Persian Gulf shipping amid Iran war
news.description: The insurance giant will work with the U.S. International Development Finance Corp. to help backstop shipping.

news.title: Iran war: Trump says he's not worried about domestic terror attack
news.description: President Donald Trump said oil companies should send tankers through the Strait of Hormuz, which has remained effectively closed due to the war on Iran.

news.title: Food prices could rise as Iran conflict disrupts fertilizer supply chain
news.description: The Iran conflict is disrupting fertilizer shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, raising supply concerns and potentially increasing global food inflation.
